name: progress-desk
description: A progress bar above the prompt that follows the chat's to-do list in every chat, plus a live panel (/desk) of what each subagent is doing.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, ru or he

autoOpen.title: Open the agents panel
autoOpen.description: any: once per chat when a subagent starts; never: only with /desk
